title: net1's traffic head on validation links, against the classifiers of run 177
description: net1's traffic head was trained on the fixed rule's steps on the 132 training links, without BBRv3 or Westwood (exp-net1-traffic-data-178; release model-net2-v6-head). This scores it, unchanged, on the 21 validation links of exp-net2-competitor-info-177, where a classifier fitted on held-out folds of those links reached 0.753 balanced accuracy from the raw measurements and 0.496 from net1 v6's beliefs. It reports the balanced accuracy, the confusions between copies and a stock flow, and per competitor the share of steps called each class and the mean P(copies) that a policy's copies belief reads; BBRv3 and Westwood are competitors the head never saw.
